lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Astral Gym! Where stars are literally made. Chad Emberstorm trained here! His membership is why we're here.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What about it?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: He's been trying to cancel it for TEN YEARS. The contract keeps auto-renewing. It's draining the Guild treasury. Tonight... we cancel.

lines.speaker: Cerberus
lines.text: Welcome! / Would you like to add towel service? / ...please hold, I'm on with billing—

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We're here to cancel a membership.
All three heads stop. All three heads laugh. It is not a kind laugh.
The deepest vault. A single sheet of paper floats in a pillar of light. It is aware of you.

lines.speaker: The Contract
lines.text: CLAUSE 1: MEMBERSHIP IS ETERNAL. CLAUSE 2: SEE CLAUSE 1.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: We're here IN PERSON. Per your own terms! CANCEL THE MEMBERSHIP.

lines.speaker: The Contract
lines.text: IN-PERSON CANCELLATION REQUIRES... DEFEATING THE PAPERWORK. IT ALWAYS HAS. READ THE FINE PRINT.

lines.speaker: The Contract
lines.text: MEMBERSHIP... CANCELLED... no hard feelings... please rate your experience...
Across the realm, Chad Emberstorm feels a weight lift that no barbell ever matched. He sheds a single, proud tear.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: On to the source, hero. The Department of Doom itself. Bring EVERY form we own.
At the front desk, a familiar knight scans membership cards. His armor bears no logos. It looks... naked.

lines.speaker: Sir Prestige
lines.text: The sponsors dropped me. CrunchQuest. PermitPal. Even the granola people's granola people. Turns out I was never... the product.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: You were never the product, Prestige. You were just a guy who could have been decent.

lines.speaker: Sir Prestige
lines.text: ...could have?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Could still.
The free-weights nebula parts. Something primordial racks its dumbbells — moons, mostly — and turns.

lines.speaker: Titan of Gainz
lines.text: YOU LIFT?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Emotionally.

lines.speaker: Titan of Gainz
lines.text: RESPECT. NOW DIE ANYWAY. IT'S ARM DAY.
The contract vault. A voice memo from Chad Emberstorm plays on loop: "You got this. Cancel my membership. Feel the burn. The LEGAL burn."

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: For Chad. For the Guild treasury. For everyone who ever tried to cancel anything.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: One more rep.
